metadata.name: polypad_launch
metadata.description: Polypad launch: coins on Meteora DBC quoted in pTokens, and the fee vault (Solana port of LaunchFactory + FeeVault)

instructions.name: accept_payee
docs: The proposed payee accepts. Fees already owed stay with the old
payee (they are owed per payee, as on the EVM); new ones are theirs.

instructions.name: burn_leftover
docs: Burn the coins in the vault's coin account: DBC's leftover above the
burn cap (sent here by its permissionless `withdraw_leftover`). The
EVM sends its unsold remainder to DEAD; here supply really drops.
Graduated coins only: DBC sends a leftover only after migration, and
a coin that graduated had its record before its mint existed, so
the sweeps (which refuse a mint with a record) never left the
platform owed anything in it. A record made later for a mint that
already existed (a look-alike pool's) never graduates, so what the
platform is owed in that mint is never burned.

instructions.name: collect
docs: `Graduator.collect` and the curve's `_payFee` together: claim the
coin's pToken fees from its DBC pool and, once graduated, from its
locked DAMM v2 position; split each by the coin's creator share;
credit the payee and the platform, and keep the holders' part on the
record. Only this collect's balance change counts, so other coins'
fees in the shared vault account and donations are never touched.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Pays the rent of any fee account created here.

accounts.name: vault_ptoken
docs: The vault's pToken account for this market, shared by its coins:
fees are measured as this collect's balance change, never swept.

accounts.name: vault_coin
docs: The vault's coin account: the token A side of both claims (always 0
with fees taken in pToken), and where DBC's leftover lands.

instructions.name: expire_launch
docs: Close the record of a launch whose pool was not opened before its
quote expired (the bundle's second transaction never landed, or the
creator opened the pool later on a curve sized at a stale price).
Anyone; the rent goes back to the creator. Such a coin can never be
launched again (its config exists), and a pool on its config is then
a look-alike whose fees `sweep_fees` takes for the platform.

instructions.name: graduate
docs: Graduate a completed coin: run DBC's `migration_damm_v2` through the
pinned `Hv8L…` config, unless someone already has (DBC lets anyone,
and accepts no other config for our fee option), then record the
DAMM v2 pool and the fee vault's position. Anyone may send the
migrating call (the recorded position is then the one DBC made from
the NFT mint signing it); our keeper sends it as soon as the curve
completes.
If someone migrated first, the call fails on its accounts and only
the keeper may resend it, naming the position DBC made (the first
position of DBC's migration transaction): a third party can fund,
lock and hand our vault a position identical to DBC's, so a
permissionless record would let it strand the real one's fees.
Nothing a third party adds to the pool can block graduation: the
position is checked against the liquidity DBC's migration puts in
it, a number fixed at launch, never against the pool's live total.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the DAMM v2 accounts' rent when this call migrates; must be
the keeper when it does not.

accounts.name: position
docs: discriminator checks; its pool, NFT and liquidity are checked, and
its NFT mint is the signing one when this call migrates.

accounts.name: position_nft_account
docs: for the fee vault.

accounts.name: position_nft_mint
docs: The position NFT mint, when this call migrates (a fresh keypair).

accounts.name: second_position_nft_mint
docs: DBC's second position (rounding dust, the creator's), when this call
migrates: DBC refuses if it is needed and missing.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Create the factory. Only the program's upgrade authority can, so
nobody can front-run the deployment with their own owner.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The program's upgrade authority: nobody else can take the factory first.

instructions.name: launch
docs: `LaunchFactory.launch`: a coin on the market of `quote`, its curve
sized at the quoted BUY price. The transaction's previous instruction
must be the ed25519 verification of `quote` by the exchange's signer
(the quote is not consumed, as on the EVM). `base_mint` is the coin's
fresh mint keypair, which DBC's pool creation then initializes. With
`first_buy > 0` the creator also mints pTokens for `first_buy` USDC at
the same quote, for the DBC `swap2` that follows the pool creation.

accounts.name: exchange_config
docs: Writable for the first buy's `mint`; this program never writes it.

accounts.name: dbc_config
docs: so no one else can make a config at this address.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: The coin's fresh mint keypair (DBC creates the mint with it). Its
signature means nobody can make a config for someone else's mint, and
only its holder can create the pool this launch records.

instructions.name: propose_payee
docs: Start moving a coin's payee (the EVM `setPayee`, made two-step: a
mistyped address would lose the coin's fees for good). Default cancels.

instructions.name: set_config
docs: `setConfig`: the platform payee and the graduation size, $1k-$1M.
Coins already launched keep their curve; owed fees stay with the old
platform. The platform may be any wallet, a creator's or payee's
included: its `Owed` accounts have their own seed, so `collect`
credits both sides apart.

instructions.name: set_fees
docs: `setFees`, for coins launched from now on: the curve fee 0.25-2%,
each creator share 30-80%; the pool fee is the DAMM v2 config's 1%.

instructions.name: sweep_fees
docs: Claim the partner fees DBC holds for our vault on a pool that is not
a Polypad coin, for the platform: anyone can open more pools on a
coin's config, or make a config naming our vault, and their trades
pay us partner fees that `collect` never touches (it claims only the
pool in a `Launch` record). Keeper only. A pool whose base or quote
mint has a `Launch` record is refused: a coin's own pool so its fees
always go through its split (an expired launch's record must be
closed first), and a look-alike quoted in a coin so nothing is ever
owed in a coin's mint, whose vault balance `burn_leftover` burns.

accounts.name: fee_vault
docs: config's fee claimer).

accounts.name: launch
docs: coin whose fees `collect` splits.

accounts.name: quote_launch
docs: ever owed in a coin's mint.

instructions.name: sweep_position_fees
docs: Claim the fees of a DAMM v2 position our vault holds in a pool that
is not a Polypad coin's, for the platform. DBC's migration hands our
vault the LP of any pool on a config naming it, and anyone may run
that migration: on a coin's pool opened too late (it never
graduates here), on another pool opened on a coin's config, or on a
look-alike config's pool. Those locked positions would otherwise
earn fees nobody can claim. Keeper only, like `sweep_fees`, and
refused (IsCoin) when either of the pool's mints has a `Launch`
record: a coin's own position goes through `collect`, and nothing is
ever owed in a coin's mint. A late coin's record is closed first
(`expire_launch`).

instructions.name: transfer_ownership
docs: Two-step ownership; there is no renounce (as on the EVM factory).

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: `FeeVault.withdraw`: everything owed to the signer in one mint.

instructions.name: withdraw_holders
docs: Move up to `amount` of a coin's holder share to the payout wallet,
from which the keeper pays holders by their indexed balances (D3).

accounts.name: to
docs: Only the payout wallet's: a stolen keeper key cannot pay itself.

errors.name: WrongSide
errors.msg: quote is for the other side

errors.name: QuoteTooLong
errors.msg: quote valid for longer than MAX_VALIDITY

errors.name: NotEd25519
errors.msg: no ed25519 verification right before this instruction

errors.name: BadEd25519Header
errors.msg: ed25519 instruction is malformed or reads outside its own data

errors.name: BadSignature
errors.msg: quote not signed by the oracle signer

errors.name: NotTopLevel
errors.msg: launch must be a top-level instruction

errors.name: ConfigMismatch
errors.msg: DBC config is not what launch asked for

errors.name: MissingAccount
errors.msg: an account this path needs is missing

errors.name: WrongAccount
errors.msg: an account is not the one expected

errors.name: NotLocked
errors.msg: the pool position is not locked and owned by the fee vault

errors.name: PoolTooLate
errors.msg: the pool was opened after the launch quote expired

errors.name: NotExpired
errors.msg: the launch's pool was opened in time

errors.name: IsCoin
errors.msg: this pool is a Polypad coin: its fees go through collect

types.name: Config
docs: `PriceOracle` + `PExchange` contract-wide state. PDA `["exchange"]`; it is
also the authority of the float vault and every pToken mint.

fields.name: pending_owner
docs: Two-step ownership: the new owner accepts.

fields.name: keeper
docs: Pauses and settles markets, reports backing, sends float to the bridge, may halt.

fields.name: factory
docs: May create pTokens for new markets (the launch program's signer).

fields.name: signer
docs: Signs quotes (ed25519). Default = revoked: no quote verifies.

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: Pinned at initialize: the only mint the float is held in.

fields.name: bridge_deposit
docs: Polymarket bridge deposit token account. Default = none.

fields.name: bridge_ever_set
docs: Set once a bridge deposit has been in place; later ones wait BRIDGE_DELAY.

fields.name: halted
docs: Every mint, redeem, release and queue payment refused while set.

fields.name: settle_fee_bps
docs: Fee on redemptions of a settled market, bps of the payout.

fields.name: meter_sales
docs: Whether sales at a quote count against the hourly cap too. Payouts of
settled markets always do.

fields.name: default_max_risk
docs: USDC a market's unbacked supply may lose if its price went to $1, unless overridden.

fields.name: max_total_risk
docs: USDC all markets' unbacked supply together may lose.

fields.name: total_risk
docs: Sum of every market's stored `risk`, 12 decimals.

fields.name: outflow_floor
docs: The hourly redemption cap is never below this, USDC.

fields.name: outflow_float_bps
docs: The hourly redemption cap as a share of the float, bps.

fields.name: queued
docs: USDC owed to the queue, including claims set aside for their owners.

fields.name: unclaimed_total
docs: Set-aside claims' USDC: reserved for those owners, never paid to the queue.

fields.name: claim_head
docs: The queue is `claim_head..claim_tail`, oldest first.

fields.name: aside_next
docs: Next index for a claim set aside at a release (its own namespace, never in line).

fields.name: delayed_next
docs: Next delayed-sale ticket.

types.name: Factory
docs: `LaunchFactory` state. PDA `["factory"]`; it is also the exchange's
`factory` signer, so it alone may create markets there.

fields.name: keeper
docs: Pays holders: may move a coin's holder share to `holder_payout`, nothing else.

fields.name: platform
docs: Receives the platform side of every fee (as `Owed`).

fields.name: holder_payout
docs: The wallet the keeper pays holders from (D3). Set by the owner, so a
stolen keeper key cannot send the holders' share anywhere else.

types.name: Fees
docs: Fees fixed per coin at launch (the EVM `Fees` struct). The pool fee is in
bps here (100 = 1%), not Uniswap v4 hundredths of a bip.

types.name: FeesCollected
docs: One `collect`: pToken claimed from the curve and from the pool, and how
the total was split.

types.name: FeesSwept
docs: Partner fees claimed from a DBC pool that is not a Polypad coin (one
opened on our config or a look-alike's), credited to the platform.

fields.name: migrated_here
docs: Whether this `graduate` ran DBC's migration itself, or found it done.

types.name: HourFloat
docs: The free float at the first mint or redeem of `hour`, before that trade
moved it (`amount`), and the hour's cap base: the lower of it and the last
such snapshot (`base`).

types.name: Launch
docs: One coin: what `LaunchFactory` registered and what the FeeVault keeps
per coin. PDA `["launch", base_mint]`. Its existence is what makes a
DBC pool a Polypad coin (METEORA.md M8): the indexer and every
instruction here accept only `pool` and `dbc_config` from this record.

fields.name: dbc_config
docs: PDA `["dbc_config", base_mint]`, created by `launch` and by nothing else.

fields.name: pool
docs: The DBC pool `launch` required in its transaction. Other pools on the
same config can exist (DBC lets anyone open one); they are not this coin.

fields.name: pool_deadline
docs: The quote's `valid_until`: the pool must be opened by then (in the
launch transaction or its bundle), or the curve, sized at that quote's
price, is stale. A pool opened later never graduates or collects
here, and anyone can close the record (`expire_launch`).

fields.name: payee
docs: Receives the creator side less the holders' part. Two-step transfer.

fields.name: holders_bps
docs: Share of the creator side kept for holders (D3), fixed at launch.

fields.name: price
docs: The quoted BUY price the curve was sized at, and the curve's numbers.

fields.name: graduated
docs: Set by `graduate` once DBC has migrated the curve into DAMM v2.

fields.name: damm_config
docs: The DAMM v2 config the pool was created under (always `Hv8L…`).

fields.name: locked_liquidity
docs: The fee vault position's permanently locked liquidity: exactly what
DBC's migration put in it.

fields.name: holders_owed
docs: Holders' pToken not yet moved to the payout wallet.

fields.name: curve_fees
docs: pToken fees collected, before the split, per source.

types.name: LaunchExpired
docs: A launch whose pool was not opened before its quote expired: the record
is closed, and any pool opened on its config is only a look-alike.

types.name: Outflow
docs: Metered USDC per clock hour. The EVM mapping is only ever read for the
current hour and the one before, so two slots hold all of it.

types.name: Owed
docs: Tokens owed to one payee (a creator's payee or the platform), across
every coin of that market: the EVM `owed[asset][payee]`, so fees already
owed stay with the old payee when a coin's payee changes. PDA
`["owed", mint, payee]` for a payee, `["platform_owed", mint, platform]`
for the platform. `mint` is a pToken, or for fees swept from look-alike
pools whatever those pools paid in.

types.name: PositionFeesSwept
docs: Fees claimed from a DAMM v2 position our vault holds in a pool that is
not a Polypad coin's (a late coin's or a look-alike's, migrated by
anyone), credited to the platform.
